regulatory_framework: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations
base_regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011
source_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
disclaimer: This is a Z-SeHealth application-level reference dataset. The regulatory_status field reflects Z-SeHealth's interpretation of applicable FSSAI regulations for additive resolution purposes. The zsehealth_risk_tier and penalty_points are Z-SeHealth's own heuristic scoring policy and are NOT official FSSAI statutory risk classifications. Regulatory permissions depend on food category, permitted use level, concentration, and population. This dataset does not constitute legal compliance advice.
notes: FINAL/NOTIFIED amendments (up to Amendment No. 84, 2025) are incorporated where evidence is available.
DRAFT regulations (2026 consultation papers) are NOT included as authoritative data.
verified=true records have been sourced from FSSAI regulatory instruments.
verified=false records carry partial or unconfirmed provenance and should not be treated as authoritative.
ADI values are included only where FSSAI or JECFA has established them; they are not fabricated.
context_dependent status means regulatory approval depends on food category, use level, or population group.
is_fssai_approved=true is assigned only to verified_permitted records with minimal conditions.
Unknown additive in the registry: penalty_points=-2, zsehealth_risk_tier=unclassified.

entries.risk_description: Dipeptide methyl ester sweetener. Approximately 180-200 times sweeter than sucrose. Permitted in FSSAI regulations at specified levels. WHO IARC assessed as 'possibly carcinogenic to humans' (Group 2B) in July 2023 based on limited evidence; JECFA simultaneously reaffirmed its ADI as adequate for safety. FSSAI has not yet published a specific amendment in response.
entries.mandatory_warning: Contains Phenylalanine. Not suitable for individuals with Phenylketonuria (PKU).
